newsitem.title: USA: Telecomm Industries to buy Unitel.
newsitem.headline: Telecomm Industries to buy Unitel.

text.p: Telecomm Industries says it has entered into a definitive $4.7 million merger agreement with privately held Unitel, of Indiana.
Unitel is currently the subject of an involuntary bankruptcy petition, filed by three of its creditors.
Telecomm said in a statement that it hopes it can resolve the Chapter 7 petition, filed in the Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Indiana, and proceed with the merger.

The company said upon completion of the merger, it will transfer to Unitel two million shares of Telecomm stock, a $1 million convertible promissory note and assume $1.2 million in certain Unitel liabilities.
Telecomm said it hopes to complete the deal in the third quarter.
The company said it is currently the largest voice and data distributor for Ameritech, while also providing services to LCI International, Nortel, Toshiba, Ascend Communications and Cisco Systems
